mike-support: Heads-up: ACME ticket — streaming responses stop with partial JSON after long idle (~2-3m). They see client reconnect loop and some 401s. Sharing repro + logs below.

lisa-customer: Repro steps I ran: open stream, wait ~120s idle, then prompt a short message. Server sends first few tokens then connection drops. Client reconnects and often gets a 401 on resume. Happens behind Cloudflare + ALB.

jamie-eng: Oof. Can you paste the raw response chunks and the request headers (esp. Connection, Keep-Alive, CF- and ALB-related headers)? Also which SDK?

lisa-customer: SDK is our in-house tiny client (uses fetch streaming in browser). Logs:
```
RESPONSE CHUNKS: \n{"id":"abc","text":"Hello, this is a lo"\n<socket close>\nclient reconnect\n401 Unauthorized (no session)\n```
Request headers (redacted):
- Host: api.redwood.example.com
- Connection: keep-alive
- Accept: text/event-stream
- CF-Visitor: {"scheme":"https"}
- Via: 1.1 cloudflare
- X-Forwarded-Proto: https

jamie-eng: Thanks. Looks like chunk boundary got truncated mid-token. Two likely suspects: 1) upstream proxy (ALB/NLB/nginx) half-closes idle TCP connections, 2) Cloudflare HTTP/2 <> HTTP/1.1 conversion & buffering behavior causing delayed flush.

alex-sre: Agreed. Also seeing 401s on reconnect suggests session token lifetime tied to connection or short auth cookie. If reconnect creates a new session and tokens are single-use, that explains the 401.

mike-support: Repro attempt I did from our end:
```
# simulate long idle then send next prompt
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 "https://api.redwood.internal/v1/streams/conv123?keepalive=15" | sed -n '1,200p'
```
After ~75s nothing, then chunk: `{"text":"partial..."` then connection FIN.

jamie-eng: Two immediate mitigations: 1) implement low-overhead keepalive bytes every 15s from server (a single `:\n` SSE comment or ping) so proxies don't hit idle TCP timeout; 2) increase ALB idle timeout to >300s for streaming routes (if customer can). Both reduce chance of half-close.

alex-sre: Additional notes: Cloudflare by default will buffer responses for certain origin types and will convert HTTP/2 to multiplexed streams. We saw cases where CF aggregated small writes and then a downstream LB closed the connection mid-aggregation leading to truncated chunk. Recommend disabling response buffering for that route and enabling "Origin Keepalive" in CF. Also try disabling HTTP/2 at CF for affected origin to test.

lisa-customer: Where do we put the SSE ping in our code? Will it affect billing/perf?

jamie-eng: Put a lightweight SSE comment: `:\n` or `: keepalive\n\n` every 10-20s — negligible tokens and bytes, not counted as model tokens. In server code (node example):
```
res.write(':\n'); // heartbeat comment
res.flush();
```
If using a compiled runtime, use kernel flush path so vm/socket drains immediately.

alex-sre: Also check ALB vs NLB behavior: ALB is HTTP layer and may send a 502/finish if origin half-closed; NLB is L4 and will pass through. If customer uses ALB in front of autoscaling group + CF, changing to NLB or setting sticky idle policy can help.

mike-support: I captured tcpdump on origin when it happened:
```
... [TCP FIN from LB], origin sent \n{"text":"...lo"\n then RST
```
That lines up with half-close during a buffered chunk.

jamie-eng: Action items:
- Customer: try server heartbeat (10s).
- Customer: set Cloudflare route to disable buffering + enable origin keepalive or temporarily turn off HTTP/2 for testing.
- Customer: if using ALB, bump idle timeout to 300s or test NLB.
- We: audit auth token to ensure reconnects don't 401 (tokens should be resumable or refreshable).

lisa-customer: Will test heartbeat and CF changes, will report back. Thanks. :pray:

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-17T14:03:21Z to prod: streaming-heartbeat-patch -> success :rocket:

jamie-eng: If they still hit truncation after keepalive + CF disable buffering, we'll ask for a small tcpdump + full raw chunk capture and we can bisect between origin runtime flush and LB close.

mike-support: Filing follow-up ticket to engineering with logs and suggested config changes. Marking high-priority for customer SLA. :white_exclamation_mark:

lisa-customer: Patch applied (heartbeat 12s), CF buffering off for route, ALB idle bumped to 300s. Re-tested for 10m idle: stream survives, no truncation so far. Thank you! :tada:
